item.title: Deleting temporary files from memory
item.description: The contents of this post fall squarely within the category of things I’d forget if I didn’t write them down. Recently I found myself in a bit of a pickle. I had the task of computing 144 months worth of exposure to pollution from coal-fired power plants for every single 10 square-km pixel over land in India. This can be done rather painlessly in R using the sf (simple features) and terra packages.
